pr_title: Fix Shape2D ignoring collision outline project setting
pr_body:
Shape2D does not honor the project setting to disable collision outlines while in the editor, however it does while in game. I assume it's just an oversight. Mentioned in #56320
Closes #56986

issue_context.title: Shape2D ignores collision outline project setting
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0dev (c13319d)

### System information

Windows 10, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960

### Issue description

Collision shapes do not honor the project setting to disable collision outlines while in the editor.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a collision shape, change the `debug/shapes/collision/draw_2d_outlines setting`.

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments: The shape is no longer causing issues, so closing this.

review_comments:
This is the same as line 118, so it makes the whole `#ifdef TOOLS_ENABLED` block redundant.

But I think that's also not a correct change, this setting is meant to configure debug views *at runtime*, not in the editor. See its documentation:

> Sets whether 2D physics will display collision outlines in game when "Visible Collision Shapes" is enabled in the Debug menu.
You bring up a good point. I guess the better option would be to make a separate Editor setting for this. I'll get on it.
